title: The visible side
notes: First routes: K-1 P1-3 for the six-face possibilities and ticket removals; grades 2-3 P1-3 for both visible clues; grades 4-5 P1-3 for conditional weights and information leaks. On return, K-1 can add tickets or design a cup (P4-7). Grades 2-3 can compare chooser rules or find all fair two-ticket cups (P4-6). Grades 4-5 can characterize every fair subset and the whole-card obstruction (P6-7). Keep the screen protocol unchanged so the mathematical clue remains color alone.
